integrity: One proved rational-function identity with finite polynomial-degree certificate; arithmetic verification also independently checks low-degree orbit counts. No claim of independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Only faithful elementary abelian order-eight actions with spherical quotient and inertia-two branch points; genus at least three for r>=5. An earlier implicit specialization of general orbit methods remains possible.
title: All-genus orbit series for elementary abelian eightfold covers
